purpose: Define explicit recovery validation, closure evidence, root-cause findings, corrective-action candidates and postmortem publication without rewriting historical incident evidence.

topics.name: Incident Recovery and Postmortem
topics.purpose: Define explicit recovery validation, closure evidence, root-cause findings, corrective-action candidates and postmortem publication without rewriting historical incident evidence.

semantics.recovery_rule: Recovery requires explicit service/data/security validation evidence.
semantics.closure_rule: Incident closure references exact recovery criteria/evidence.
semantics.root_cause_rule: Root-cause finding is evidence-backed and separate from mere temporal correlation.
semantics.action_rule: Corrective actions are candidate operations/projects until separately accepted.
semantics.history_rule: Postmortem never deletes or rewrites original incident evidence.
semantics.reopen_rule: New evidence may reopen incident explicitly.
semantics.authority_rule: Postmortem recommendations grant no execution authority.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: root cause inferred from nearest log
